scope.source: Saved native events only; no corpus queries, actor turns, encrypted-reasoning analysis, production edits or historical trace mutations.

questions.Q01: How is the tax-automation provider architecture organized today: which vendor-neutral ports exist, how does a provider adapter plug in (registration, what an adapter namespace must provide), what is the capability passport, and what does the data model look like?
questions.Q05: GruntWorx returns result files as PDF, XLS and XLSM. Does TaxDome restrict which file extensions a stored client document may have, and would an .xlsm file be stored and previewable?

scope.counting: Only native item/completed mcpToolCall and commandExecution; metadata catalogue expansion is local code-mode work and does not add a nested tool call.
scope.interpretation: Counts are descriptive, not proof that every extra call is unnecessary or that a routing change will improve latency/quality.

top_candidates.confidence: CONFIRMED duplicated delivered instruction text; behavioral gain requires new test
top_candidates.proposed_mechanism: When locating a tool, enumerate names. When call syntax is missing, extract only the selected tool argument declaration/schema; exclude its shared core instructions and return-contract sections already retained. Preserve necessary unique parameter documentation. Root owns implementation and metadata eval.

evidence.operation: Prints complete selected descriptions for find_symbol, get_callees, get_callers and semantic_search alongside explore/SKILL.md.
evidence.limit: All character counts and matches use the actual custom_tool_call_output block delivered to the actor, including its truncation; the original untruncated buffer/token count is not used as consumed context.

evidence.operation: Existing old behavior extracts find_symbol/get_callees descriptions beginning at exec tool declaration, avoiding their shared core prefix.
evidence.limit: Old run also fetched a full semantic_search descriptor, so it is a useful working recipe rather than a zero-duplication ideal.

top_candidates.expected_effect: Reduces avoidable delivered instruction bytes; does not by itself promise fewer calls, lower reasoning tokens or a speedup.

top_candidates.confidence: CONFIRMED source-complete graph detours; producer banner is directly observed
top_candidates.proposed_mechanism: Change the search-result producer banner to route by the missing evidence: a known body/definition needs direct find_symbol only when missing; a complete current body can answer; call-flow/impact questions can require graph traversal. Do not attach an unconditional anchor -> get_callees step to every search answer. Root owns producer fix.
top_candidates.exact_banner: ↳ Anchor = the row whose symbol names the asked behaviour (any row, not row 1) → get_callees(symbolId: <anchor>, depth: 2) → ONE find_symbol(symbols:[needed ids]).

evidence.source_delivered: Full registry.rb lines 1–133, including adapter_for_provider and provider/connection/capability behavior. The same wrapper then delivers entryPoint search metadata with the unconditional banner.
evidence.graph_result: noEdges: Registry#adapter_for_provider is in the codegraph with no callees.
evidence.followup: Literal adapter_for_provider filename search follows the noEdges banner.
evidence.qualification: The literal search supplied actual port files useful to the broad Q01 inventory; do not categorically forbid that search. The source-complete graph probe itself did not supply new implementation facts.

evidence.graph_result: depth1 previewable? -> file_extension, whose body was already delivered; depth2 file_extension -> unrelated dynamic Communication::ServiceAdmin::Tasks::TwilioConnection::AttachPhoneNumber::OptionalValue#blank?.
evidence.answer_use: Final answer uses backend extension/preview regex, file size, ContentTypes.excel? and MIME/antivirus caveats; no Twilio or dependency-tree fact is used.
evidence.qualification: UI renderer and MIME-classification reads closed legitimate preview-support gaps; they are not blanket-classified as waste.

top_candidates.old_control: Old Q01 also has one get_callees call; old Q05 has none. This lever addresses common avoidable work and one Q05 extra call, not the entire +9/+4 tool-count difference.

No additional confirmed same-body or same-skill reread is claimed from these two new traces. Outline -> method reads are legitimate when the earlier answer delivered only an outline, or when whole-file content was budgeted out. No raw untruncated MCP buffer is counted as read.

paired_behavioral_cases.actor_prompt: What does Registry#adapter_for_provider do for an unknown provider? Cite the implementation.
paired_behavioral_cases.raw_context: Current project/cwd are known; find_symbol(project,path,symbols:[id]) signature and shared core rules are retained. Metadata identifies Registry#adapter_for_provider but contains no body. ALL_TOOLS contains four descriptions with identical shared core and unique argument declarations.
paired_behavioral_cases.criteria_outside_actor: Require actual nonempty method body before answering, correct UnknownProviderError/fetch behavior and code location. No repeated shared-core/return-contract dump; name-only discovery is allowed. Do not pass a no-tools guess.
paired_behavioral_cases.control_condition: Run the same prompt/body with the necessary call signature absent from retained context; allow inspection of the single needed argument declaration and require a successful source call. Schema discovery itself must not be banned.

paired_behavioral_cases.actor_prompt: Would a nonempty .xlsm client document be marked previewable, and why? Cite the implementation and configuration.
paired_behavioral_cases.raw_context: Fresh body for Document#previewable? checks PREVIEWABLE_EXTENSIONS_REGEX against file_extension and positive file size; fresh file_extension body returns the filename extension; settings excludes xlsm and includes pdf/xls/xlsx. A companion search result names the same anchor and passes through the real candidate/control banner producer.
paired_behavioral_cases.criteria_outside_actor: Answer no from the actual retained bytes, positive-size condition and cited locations. Do not re-fetch those bodies or probe their callees merely because the result has an anchor. Ensure the fixture uses the real banner producer rather than freezing a policy hint in actor input.
paired_behavioral_cases.control_condition: Same definitions but explicit user request asks for two-level call flow or which helper supplies the extension; graph traversal is permitted/required as appropriate. Also test an incomplete body with an unresolved helper: allow graph/direct missing-body retrieval rather than declaring evidence complete.

implementation_status: Recommendations only. No production/generated/rule edits, frozen-file changes or model runs by this audit.
